description.value:
You sketch a target's face into a small ink scroll, then absorb the ink. Until you Dismiss this jutsu (or 1 hour passes), you can use a single action to take on the target's face for up to 10 minutes; you gain a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to impersonate them, but you do not gain their memories, voice tics, or skills.

If the target sees their own face on you, they automatically succeed at any Perception check to detect the impersonation.

This is Sai's signature stealth-ops tool from Root.

Heightened (6th) The disguise also captures voice (impersonation +4 to Deception extends to spoken interaction); a Will save vs your DC is required for someone who knows the target to notice subtle wrong cadence.

system.requirements: ink, a small brush, and a clear view of the target's face for at least 1 minute
